北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴冷，体感 -9℃。外出别忘加衣保湿哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny and cold, feels like -9℃. Don't forget to dress warmly and moisturize!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天有风，体感 -4℃。多穿点，注意防风保暖呀。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and windy, feels like -4℃. Dress warmly and stay protected from the wind.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴冷，体感 -1℃。记得多加件衣服，别着凉了。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and chilly, feels like -1℃. Remember to layer up to avoid catching a cold.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天舒适，体感 18℃。出门记得带伞，以防万一哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and pleasant, feels like 18℃. Bring an umbrella just in case.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天宜人，体感 17℃。小心湿度，享受好天气。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and pleasant, feels like 17℃. Mind the humidity and enjoy the day.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴冷风大，体感 -7℃。务必多穿防风衣物，注意保暖。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and windy, feels like -7℃. Be sure to wear windproof clothes and stay warm.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴冷，体感 -8℃。天寒地冻，多穿几层才暖和哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and freezing, feels like -8℃. Layer up to stay warm in this cold weather.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 2℃。出门注意保暖，小心着凉。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 2℃. Stay warm when you go out to avoid catching a cold.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾弥漫，体感 -6℃。出行务必注意安全，保暖防寒。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy, feels like -6℃. Please drive carefully and stay warm.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴冷干燥，体感 -6℃。多喝热水，注意防寒保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and dry, feels like -6℃. Drink more hot water and stay warm.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天潮湿，体感 4℃。小心湿冷，出门多穿点。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and humid, feels like 4℃. Be careful of the damp cold, dress warmer.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗极寒，体感 -28℃。帽子手套全副武装，暖暖和和出门。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny and extremely cold, feels like -28℃. Wear your hat and gloves, stay fully bundled up!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -28℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷，体感 -22℃。外面非常冷，保暖是关键哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and freezing, feels like -22℃. It's very cold out, keeping warm is key.
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -22℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗舒适，体感 11℃。天气真好，记得防晒补水。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and pleasant, feels like 11℃. Beautiful weather, remember sunscreen and hydration.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天微凉，体感 10℃。早晚温差大，注意添衣哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and cool, feels like 10℃. Big temperature difference, add clothes in morning/evening.
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴冷风大，体感 -12℃。裹严实点，别让寒风吹透了。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and very windy, feels like -12℃. Bundle up tight, don't let the cold wind chill you.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云极寒，体感 -21℃。风力不小，务必穿厚实防风。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and extremely cold, feels like -21℃. It's windy, wear thick, windproof clothes.
大连.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -21℃ | 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级
